adventure.title: The Reef That Sails
adventure.tagline: Your anchorage is leaving without a tide.
adventure.premise: You reach a coral anchorage to find the island carrying your missing expedition drifting seaward while your hired boat strains at its last mooring.
actions: Board the drifting reef before the mooring gives way.
Trim your boat's sail to follow the moving island safely.
Question the pearl divers about the marks on the coral.

adventure.title: A Ransom in Sailcloth
adventure.tagline: The hostage left a course only a sailmaker can read.
adventure.premise: You unfold a damaged sail at a sunlit dock and find a hostage's route stitched into its seams as the waiting privateer demands it back.
actions: Trace the stitched bearings beneath the torn sail's hem.
Stall the privateer by demanding payment for the repair.
Slip the marked seam to a trusted dockside runner.

adventure.title: The Copper Diver's Bargain
adventure.tagline: A few breaths remain beneath the salvage camp.
adventure.premise: You arrive at a floating salvage camp where a trapped diver signals from a sunken strongroom and a rival crew prepares to cut the air hose.
actions: Secure the air hose to your own weighted line.
Bargain with the rival crew for time to reach the diver.
Descend along the bubbles toward the trapped strongroom.

adventure.title: Seven Knots to Sundown
adventure.tagline: A lost knot leaves three channels and one safe passage.
adventure.premise: You board a supply brig with a knotted route-cord whose final knot comes loose just as the lookout spots three identical reef channels.
actions: Compare the loose cord with the shapes of the reef mouths.
Climb the rigging for a clear view of the breaking water.
Ask the oldest deckhand where the cord was last repaired.

adventure.title: The Orchard Above the Surf
adventure.tagline: The missing expedition is sending its trail down as fruit.
adventure.premise: You land beneath a cliff orchard to discover fresh expedition markings on falling fruit while the only rope ascent begins to unravel.
actions: Catch a marked fruit and examine the fresh cuts in its skin.
Reinforce the ascent rope with your spare coil.
Signal the cliff orchard with your polished cooking tin.

adventure.title: The Auction of Empty Chests
adventure.tagline: The only clue to your lost vessel is about to become ash.
adventure.premise: You enter a quayside salvage auction and recognize a false bottom from your lost vessel while the winning bidder orders the chest burned.
actions: Offer a rival bid before the chest reaches the brazier.
Inspect the false bottom while the porters change their grip.
Follow the buyer's runner toward the warehouse quay.

adventure.title: The Windward Drum
adventure.tagline: The flotilla needs a rhythm its broken drum can barely carry.
adventure.premise: You join a festival flotilla where a damaged signal drum holds the rhythm for crossing a reef and a squall scatters the boats before you can learn it.
actions: Copy the surviving beat onto the side of a water barrel.
Lash two scattered boats together before the squall reaches them.
Ask the drummer to signal the missing beat with a flag.

adventure.title: A Bridge of Broken Anchors
adventure.tagline: Your guide is across the ravine; your bridge is coming apart.
adventure.premise: You reach a jungle ravine where an expedition's anchor-chain bridge is pulling free and your missing guide calls from the far bank.
actions: Brace the loose anchor against the nearest stone buttress.
Call to your guide for a safe landing point beyond the gap.
Descend to the lower ledge with your climbing rope.

adventure.title: The Sandbar Post
adventure.tagline: A familiar delivery mark waits on a wreck the tide just exposed.
adventure.premise: You deliver a sealed chart to a sandbar trading post just as the tide exposes a wreck bearing tomorrow's version of your own delivery mark.
actions: Compare the wreck's mark with the seal on your chart tube.
Ask the post keeper who logged the wreck's cargo.
Secure your boat above the rising tideline before investigating.

adventure.title: The Gullkeeper's Bearing
adventure.tagline: A trained gull has brought back a piece of an absent island.
adventure.premise: You collect a trained gull from a harbor loft and find its message tube stuffed with volcanic grit as every bird wheels toward a supposedly empty horizon.
actions: Release the gull with a bright tracking streamer.
Examine the grit against the harbor's stored volcanic samples.
Hire a light skiff before the birds pass beyond the headland.

historical_adventure.title: The Seal at the Mountain Barrier
historical_adventure.tagline: The seal is sound; the description beside the gate is not.
historical_adventure.premise: You reach an Edo-period mountain barrier with an intact dispatch seal and discover that the posted travel description names the companion beside you as a fugitive.
actions: Present the sealed dispatch without surrendering your companion.
Ask the barrier guard which household issued the description.
Study the wooded detour before the gate closes.

historical_adventure.title: The Waterlogged Folio
historical_adventure.tagline: Water is rising around the folio and the person who saved it.
historical_adventure.premise: You arrive at a Hellenistic harbor workshop to collect a damaged manuscript as rising water traps its owner behind a jammed storeroom door.
actions: Lever the storeroom door with a binding press bar.
Pass dry boards through the window to raise the manuscript.
Call the neighboring boat crews to help lift the jammed frame.

historical_adventure.title: The Glassmaker's Cipher
historical_adventure.tagline: A warning has cooled inside the patron's glass.
historical_adventure.premise: You open a Renaissance furnace workshop and find a warning formed inside cooling glass while a patron's servants wait outside to seize the batch.
actions: Turn the cooling glass to read the concealed pattern.
Ask the waiting servants for the patron's receipt.
Send a workshop apprentice to warn the intended recipient.

historical_adventure.title: The Broken Relay Saddle
historical_adventure.tagline: The warning must travel farther than the relay horses will.
historical_adventure.premise: You reach a Ming relay station with a sealed flood warning and find the fresh horses taken and the downstream ferry already preparing its final crossing.
actions: Show the ferry keeper the dispatch's unbroken seal.
Ask the station workers who requisitioned the fresh horses.
Lead your tired mount toward the shorter riverbank track.

historical_adventure.title: The Measure of the Aqueduct
historical_adventure.tagline: The first water is coming toward a deliberately weakened support.
historical_adventure.premise: You inspect a provincial Roman aqueduct before a public opening and find tool marks beneath a new support as the first water surges toward it.
actions: Signal the upstream crew to hold the sluice.
Measure the fresh cuts beneath the new support.
Clear the workers from the downstream inspection passage.

historical_adventure.title: The Loom Behind the Gate
historical_adventure.tagline: A family's passage is hidden in the cloth being seized.
historical_adventure.premise: You bring cloth to a medieval city gate and discover a displaced family's travel token sewn into the bolt that a guard has ordered confiscated.
actions: Unroll the bolt to keep its sewn token in view.
Ask the gate guard to name the grounds for confiscation.
Offer another merchant your pack space in return for an introduction.

historical_adventure.title: The Ink on the Tea Bowl
historical_adventure.tagline: A bowl carries a message its recipient cannot stop to read.
historical_adventure.premise: You deliver bowls to a Joseon roadside inn and discover a message under the glaze while the intended recipient is being escorted through the courtyard.
actions: Rotate the bowl in the courtyard light to inspect its glaze.
Offer tea service to delay the departing escort.
Ask the innkeeper which road the escorted traveler will take.

historical_adventure.title: The Bridge Before the Thaw
historical_adventure.tagline: Two parties want the bridge before the river takes it.
historical_adventure.premise: You reach a seventeenth-century river crossing to repair its mooring as a thaw sends timber downstream and two armed parties demand first passage.
actions: Lash a fresh mooring around the nearest sound piling.
Call both parties to help clear the approaching timber.
Inspect the downstream bank for a safer temporary crossing.

historical_adventure.title: The Caravan's Second Weight
historical_adventure.tagline: The caravan is counting stones as water.
historical_adventure.premise: You weigh supplies at a medieval desert caravan halt and discover stones replacing water jars just as the guide announces an early departure.
actions: Open a suspect jar in front of the other travelers.
Ask the guide to delay departure while you tally the real supply.
Trace the swapped jars back through the camp's loading marks.

historical_adventure.title: The Printer's Last Forme
historical_adventure.tagline: The press is set to make a lie official.
historical_adventure.premise: You unlock an early-modern printshop to find a forged proclamation locked in the press while its sponsor waits for the first copies in the street.
actions: Lift the forme to inspect the changed lines before printing.
Ask the sponsor's messenger to verify the proclamation's seal.
Warn the shop owner through the rear delivery door.

ancient_greek.title: The Oar Beneath the Altar
ancient_greek.tagline: An offering carries the voices of a crew still waiting below.
ancient_greek.premise: You bring a votive oar to a coastal shrine and hear a wrecked crew calling through its grain as the tide withdraws from a hidden path.
actions: Listen to the oar where the temple stone amplifies its grain.
Follow the exposed path while marking the returning tide.
Ask the shrine keeper which vessel gave this wood.

ancient_greek.title: The Olive Crown's Burden
ancient_greek.tagline: The crown grows heavy where a promise is light.
ancient_greek.premise: You approach the games with a borrowed olive crown that turns to lead whenever your rival speaks and the herald calls you both to swear an oath.
actions: Ask your rival to repeat the disputed promise before the altar.
Lay the borrowed crown down and inspect its hidden fastening.
Request a witness before swearing the herald's oath.

ancient_greek.title: The Silent Bronze of Argos
ancient_greek.tagline: Bronze reflects the breach before anyone will admit it.
ancient_greek.premise: You bring a new bronze shield to a temple and see its reflection show the gate standing open while the city watch insists it is barred.
actions: Turn the shield toward the city gate to compare the image.
Ask a gate watcher to inspect the inner bar with you.
Carry the shield to the temple threshold for a clearer omen.

ancient_greek.title: The Ninth Stone of the Maze
ancient_greek.tagline: One moving stone is enough to lose the way home.
ancient_greek.premise: You reach a hillside sanctuary where a rescued child carries a moving maze-stone and the entrance shifts before the next search party can leave.
actions: Compare the stone's turns with the sanctuary floor.
Ask the rescued child where the corridor first changed.
Stretch a guide cord across the entrance before following it.

ancient_greek.title: The Unshared Loaf
ancient_greek.tagline: Bread cannot bless a threshold that refuses a guest.
ancient_greek.premise: You carry barley bread to a wayside altar and find strangers refusing each other shelter while thunder answers every broken promise.
actions: Offer the first loaf to the strangers at the edge of the fire.
Ask each traveler which promise brought them to the altar.
Gather dry branches to make shelter before the storm breaks.

ancient_greek.title: The Spear That Points Home
ancient_greek.tagline: Your arms point toward the people your orders turn away.
ancient_greek.premise: You return to a sea-cliff watchpost and find your bronze spear drawn toward a refugee boat while the signal fire orders every vessel turned away.
actions: Signal the refugee boat to hold outside the rocks.
Ask the watchpost who ordered the harbor closed.
Test the spear's pull against the headland's visible bearings.

ancient_greek.title: The Thread Across the Isthmus
ancient_greek.tagline: Two processions are walking into the same narrowing thread.
ancient_greek.premise: You deliver a ceremonial cloth to an isthmus shrine and watch its woven road unravel toward two processions about to meet on a narrow causeway.
actions: Raise the cloth so both processions can see the unraveling road.
Follow the loose thread to the causeway's weakest section.
Ask the heralds to halt while you compare their routes.

ancient_greek.title: The Wine Jar of Unsaid Vows
ancient_greek.tagline: The jar remembers the vows the company would rather forget.
ancient_greek.premise: You uncork a wine jar at a grove altar and hear the vows your companions concealed as a waiting envoy demands your oath first.
actions: Pour a small libation and listen for the oldest promise.
Ask the envoy to state the purpose of the demanded oath.
Seal the jar until your companions agree to hear it together.

ancient_greek.title: The Ash Tree at the Boundary
ancient_greek.tagline: A truce needs roots stronger than its boundary stones.
ancient_greek.premise: You reach a boundary grove where an ash tree bears two rival families' tokens and its roots begin lifting the stones before their truce is sworn.
actions: Read the two families' tokens against the shifting roots.
Ask both households to repeat the terms before witnesses.
Brace the loosening stones while the elders approach.

mythology.title: The Hearth That Forgets Its Kin
mythology.tagline: An empty place at the hearth is not an empty promise.
mythology.premise: You return to a snowbound hall where the hearth refuses warmth to one family and a guest claims the forgotten place beside your ancestors.
actions: Ask the guest whose name belongs to the cold bench.
Lay your household token beside the failing embers.
Hear the excluded family's account before the feast begins.

mythology.title: The Wolf Beneath the Keel
mythology.tagline: The vessel will float when the thing beneath it finishes counting.
mythology.premise: You trace runes on a beached longship and hear a bound wolf counting the crew beneath its keel as the tide begins to lift it.
actions: Trace the damaged binding rune along the keel.
Ask the waiting crew which oath launched this vessel.
Shore the longship above the next rise of the tide.

mythology.title: The Cup Beyond the Ninth Wave
mythology.tagline: The returning boat expects more than a cup.
mythology.premise: You reach a stone-ring shore where a cup from the otherworld washes back with an old promise and your companion steps toward its returning boat.
actions: Speak the remembered terms of the old shore bargain.
Ask your companion what the cup has promised them.
Follow the cup's wet trail back to the outer stones.

mythology.title: The Antler Road
mythology.tagline: Winter has opened a road and hidden its price.
mythology.premise: You stand before a winter stone circle when antler shadows open a road toward a captive season and the grove's last green branch starts to fade.
actions: Examine the antler shadows before stepping between them.
Tie the living branch to a stone where it can be found again.
Call into the road for the captive season's own account.

mythology.title: The Weight of the Unfinished Name
mythology.tagline: A missing name has made an unjust weight.
mythology.premise: You enter a mythic weighing hall bearing a broken name tablet and find the scales tipping against someone whose final act has been erased.
actions: Fit the broken tablet against the empty place on the scale.
Ask the waiting soul to name the act no record preserves.
Request that the weighing pause until a witness is heard.

mythology.title: The Door of Borrowed Dawn
mythology.tagline: Your household has promised away the morning.
mythology.premise: You climb a frostbound ridge to light the morning beacon and find dawn pledged as payment for an oath your household never heard.
actions: Read the old pledge beneath the frost on the beacon stone.
Light a small witness flame before offering any new oath.
Ask the unseen creditor what debt the first promise answered.

mythology.title: The Ferryman's Winter Guest
mythology.tagline: Spring is waiting on the wrong side of a remembered kindness.
mythology.premise: You reach an icebound ferry stone where a silent traveler carries spring beneath a cloak and the river demands a remembered kindness as its fare.
actions: Ask the traveler what help they have given along the road.
Offer the river a true account of a kindness you witnessed.
Inspect the ferry stone for the terms of an earlier crossing.

mythology.title: The Hammer Under the Feast
mythology.tagline: Every oath at the feast strikes a hidden anvil.
mythology.premise: You bring a repaired hammer to a mountain feast and hear it strike from beneath the floor whenever a guest swears loyalty to the host.
actions: Set the repaired hammer against the sounding floorboards.
Ask the host to explain the oldest oath of the hall.
Mark which guests make the buried blows grow louder.

mythology.title: The Stag at the Last Ember
mythology.tagline: The last ember can be saved, but an oath must still mean something.
mythology.premise: You tend a hilltop vigil where a white stag guards the final ember and a voice from the stones offers to save it by taking your oldest promise.
actions: Ask the voice whose loss would keep the ember alive.
Sing the history of the promise before accepting new terms.
Offer the stag shelter from the wind while you inspect the stones.

psychedelic_trip.title: The Orchard of Borrowed Echoes
psychedelic_trip.tagline: Tomorrow's farewell has ripened before its speaker is ready.
psychedelic_trip.premise: You step into an orchard where fruit repeats tomorrow's farewells and a transparent gardener asks which voice you will return before the roots learn it.
actions: Taste the echo in the lowest silver fruit.
Ask the transparent gardener whose roots are learning the voice.
Hum a new greeting into the branch before it closes.

psychedelic_trip.title: The Staircase That Tastes of Rain
psychedelic_trip.tagline: A folding sun is closing the landing above your tongue.
psychedelic_trip.premise: You cross a doorway into stairs that taste blue beneath your feet while a paper sun folds shut around the landing you meant to reach.
actions: Follow the taste of rain toward the next indigo step.
Ask the paper sun to leave one crease unfolded.
Sketch the staircase's changing rhythm in the air.

psychedelic_trip.title: The Museum of Almost
psychedelic_trip.tagline: A possibility has stepped out to look for its missing choice.
psychedelic_trip.premise: You enter a museum of choices never made and find your unfinished reflection climbing out of its frame as the corridors rearrange around its footsteps.
actions: Match your reflection's pace without entering its frame.
Ask the nearest unfinished portrait which corridor remembers you.
Turn the empty frame toward a choice you can still make.

psychedelic_trip.title: A Sea Sewn from Sleeves
psychedelic_trip.tagline: Your coat has become a sea that needs a reason to sail.
psychedelic_trip.premise: You unfold a coat into a phosphorescent sea where the buttons are islands and a needle-shaped boat demands the memory that will serve as its sail.
actions: Offer the boat a remembered direction rather than a destination.
Unfasten one island-button to slow the phosphorescent current.
Ask the needle boat which stitch keeps the sea together.

psychedelic_trip.title: The Choir Under Your Footprint
psychedelic_trip.tagline: One footprint is singing after its walker has vanished.
psychedelic_trip.premise: You arrive on a shore of humming footprints and hear one singing without its walker while a tide of silence approaches the unfinished song.
actions: Answer the lonely footprint with a note of your own.
Follow the fading song away from the tide of silence.
Ask the surrounding footprints what shape the walker left.

psychedelic_trip.title: The Umbrella of Sideways Seasons
psychedelic_trip.tagline: Four seasons are falling; only one can find the ground.
psychedelic_trip.premise: You open an umbrella under a violet sky and four seasons fall sideways from its ribs as a snowflower asks you to choose which season may touch ground.
actions: Tilt the umbrella toward the season the snowflower can bear.
Ask each falling season what it will leave behind.
Catch one sideways raindrop to weigh its unspent spring.

psychedelic_trip.title: The Door in the Sleeping Color
psychedelic_trip.tagline: Amber has fallen asleep with every yellow door locked inside it.
psychedelic_trip.premise: You enter a field where amber has fallen asleep and every yellow doorway locks while a blue silhouette offers its own outline as a temporary key.
actions: Listen for the sleeping color's slowest pulse.
Ask the blue silhouette what lending its outline will cost.
Trace a temporary doorway using the dawn at your feet.

psychedelic_trip.title: The Parade of Unfinished Faces
psychedelic_trip.tagline: The procession is waiting for a name you have not given it.
psychedelic_trip.premise: You cross a bridge of folded laughter into a procession of blank masks and find the final face forming from the name you have not yet spoken.
actions: Turn the unfinished mask toward a sound that belongs to nobody.
Ask the nearest blank face where the parade began.
Fold a bridge of laughter toward the procession's open end.

cosmic_horror.title: The Parallax in Plate Six
cosmic_horror.tagline: The second horizon moves when the telegram is spoken.
cosmic_horror.premise: You develop an expedition plate beneath a green archive lamp and find its second horizon shifting closer whenever your colleague's telegram is read aloud.
actions: Compare the developed plate with its unopened companion exposure.
Stop reading and measure whether the second horizon holds still.
Seal the telegram in the archive's lightproof case.

cosmic_horror.title: A Catalogue of Missing Angles
cosmic_horror.tagline: The survey measures a room by the angles it removes.
cosmic_horror.premise: You inspect a donated building survey and discover a room measured only in missing angles while footsteps begin occupying that same absence above your desk.
actions: Copy the missing angles onto a separate sheet without completing them.
Ask the night custodian which floor lies above the archive.
Leave the survey open and test the footsteps from the corridor.

cosmic_horror.title: The Ninth Transit
cosmic_horror.tagline: The telescope has turned toward an entry you have not written.
cosmic_horror.premise: You reach an observatory with eight recorded transits and find a ninth already entered in your handwriting as the telescope turns toward the floor.
actions: Cover the eyepiece before inspecting the ninth observation.
Compare the ink with the untouched pen on your desk.
Ask the distant receiving station whether it logged the same transit.

cosmic_horror.title: The Fossil That Remembers Air
cosmic_horror.tagline: An extinct coast is breathing behind a sealed wall.
cosmic_horror.premise: You unpack a fossil in a university workroom and hear it exhale the precise weather of a vanished coast while condensation outlines a door on the sealed wall.
actions: Record the exhalation without opening the condensation outline.
Compare the fossil's cavity with the expedition's packing sketch.
Close the workroom vents and observe which moisture remains.

cosmic_horror.title: The Address Beneath the Stamp
cosmic_horror.tagline: The letter was posted somewhere below the ordinary map.
cosmic_horror.premise: You examine a missing colleague's letter and find its postmark naming a depth rather than a town while seawater darkens the archive steps outside.
actions: Compare the depth mark with the expedition's last soundings.
Move the open letter away from the darkening archive steps.
Ask the night porter when the first water appeared.

cosmic_horror.title: The Silence Between Two Bells
cosmic_horror.tagline: The gap between two bells is becoming a place.
cosmic_horror.premise: You compare wax recordings in a locked study and hear an expanding silence between identical bells as the window glass begins reflecting a larger room.
actions: Stop one recording to test whether the silence still expands.
Measure the reflected room against the visible window frame.
Cover the glass before replaying the first cylinder alone.

cosmic_horror.title: The Index of Unborn Readers
cosmic_horror.tagline: The index knows the outline of readers who are not here yet.
cosmic_horror.premise: You open an uncatalogued index under leaded archive windows and find future readers listed by the shapes of their shadows as your own detaches from the chair.
actions: Close the index without touching the detached shadow.
Compare its final entry with the chair's changing outline.
Call a colleague to observe from outside the leaded window.

zombie.title: The Dialysis Window
zombie.tagline: One powered station cannot solve two interrupted treatments.
zombie.premise: You begin a clinic shift when backup lighting fails and an evacuation message leaves one powered treatment station between two patients as infected figures reach the locked entrance.
actions: Check the transfer kits and backup battery before moving either patient.
Ask the evacuation team to confirm a receiving clinic.
Brace the entrance while the waiting staff prepare a safe transfer.

zombie.title: The Laundry Chute Route
zombie.tagline: The service floor's only clear route was built for linen.
zombie.premise: You collect linen on a hospital service floor when a quarantine shutter drops and a colleague signals from beyond it beside the only clear laundry chute.
actions: Check the chute's lower landing before attempting a descent.
Ask your colleague to pass the keycard beneath the shutter.
Secure a linen line to the fixed stair rail for a controlled retreat.

zombie.title: The Cold Chain Detour
zombie.tagline: Your delivery is warming while the receiving bay falls.
zombie.premise: You bring temperature-sensitive supplies to a relief depot and find its receiving bay compromised while your cooler alarm counts down beside a waiting family.
actions: Check the sealed cooler against the alternate depot address.
Signal the waiting family toward the screened side entrance.
Call the relief coordinator to confirm a clear unloading point.

zombie.title: The School Bus at Triage
zombie.tagline: The safe gate is closing before the last passengers arrive.
zombie.premise: You reach a temporary triage lot with an empty school bus as the shelter closes its gate and a stranded group pounds on an adjacent clinic window.
actions: Ask the gate team to hold a visible pickup lane.
Signal the clinic group toward the bus's sheltered side.
Inspect the service-road exit before committing the bus.

zombie.title: The Red Light in the Kennel
zombie.tagline: The dogs can hear the danger gathering outside.
zombie.premise: You open a shelter's isolation wing after a quarantine alert and find a bitten volunteer holding the keys while frightened dogs threaten to draw the infected outside.
actions: Ask the volunteer to set the keys down without approaching.
Close the inner sound barrier to quiet the frightened dogs.
Radio the evacuation team with the isolation wing's location.

zombie.title: The Apartment Intercom Test
zombie.tagline: A resident is waiting above a stairwell full of movement.
zombie.premise: You test an apartment intercom after a lockdown broadcast and hear a trapped resident whisper from a floor whose stairwell camera shows movement at every landing.
actions: Ask the resident to stay behind a locked interior door.
Compare the camera landings to locate a clear service route.
Test the roof intercom without opening the stairwell access.

apocalypse.title: The Filter Beneath the Ash
apocalypse.tagline: A clean filter waits below a fast-moving wall of dust.
apocalypse.premise: You emerge into an ash valley to find a fallen clinic holding the last compatible water filter while a dust front closes over its exposed basement.
actions: Check the basement opening for a second way out.
Secure a guide line before entering the clinic ruin.
Trade your spare cell to the scavenger watching the storm.

apocalypse.title: The Last Dry Bearing
apocalypse.tagline: One bearing can keep two camps from going dark.
apocalypse.premise: You reach a rusting wind tower with one replacement bearing and discover its power line also feeds the settlement that drove your caravan away.
actions: Inspect the tower's shared power junction before climbing.
Ask the rival settlement for help lifting the replacement.
Calculate which loads can wait while the turbine is stopped.

apocalypse.title: The Toll of Green Copper
apocalypse.tagline: The cheaper path may cost more than copper.
apocalypse.premise: You enter a reclaimed rail cutting where traders demand copper for safe passage and your radiation meter rises beside the only alternative path.
actions: Test the alternative route from the cutting's sheltered edge.
Offer a useful repair instead of the full copper toll.
Ask another caravan what the passage fee actually protects.

apocalypse.title: The Seed Bank's Warm Wall
apocalypse.tagline: The power to open the bank is also keeping its seeds alive.
apocalypse.premise: You inspect a buried seed bank and find roots warming its refrigeration wall while your failing battery can power either the doors or the cooling system.
actions: Inspect the root-warmed wall for a manual service hatch.
Ration the battery between a short door cycle and cooling.
Ask the neighboring camp to lend a hand generator.

apocalypse.title: The Rain Catcher's Shadow
apocalypse.tagline: The rain is clean; the place where it will land is not.
apocalypse.premise: You climb an abandoned overpass to test a rain-catching rig and spot a clean cloud moving toward a contaminated basin where another camp has already gathered.
actions: Signal the other camp before the cloud reaches the basin.
Rig a clean catch sheet above the contaminated ground.
Test the first drops against the basin's runoff.

real_life.title: The Shift Nobody Claimed
real_life.tagline: Two tired coworkers were promised the same morning.
real_life.premise: You unlock a station cafe before rush hour and find the rota changed overnight while two exhausted coworkers each insist the opening shift was promised to the other.
actions: Compare the changed rota with the shift messages.
Ask both coworkers which hours they can actually cover.
Call the owner before opening the busiest service window.

real_life.title: The Ramp Before the Opening
real_life.tagline: The opening cannot be welcoming until the entrance works.
real_life.premise: You reach a small exhibition venue and discover the hired access ramp does not fit as the first invited guests arrive outside its stepped entrance.
actions: Measure the doorway and the ramp before moving equipment.
Ask the venue team to open the accessible side entrance.
Tell the arriving guests plainly what is being fixed.

real_life.title: The Interview Without a Room
real_life.tagline: One panel, one slot, two people trying to stay composed.
real_life.premise: You arrive for a final interview and find another candidate assigned the same panel and time while the receptionist asks which of you will go first.
actions: Show the receptionist your confirmation without blaming the other candidate.
Ask the panel coordinator to explain the duplicated booking.
Compare availability with the other candidate for a fair adjustment.

real_life.title: The Deposit on Table Four
real_life.tagline: Two anniversaries have arrived for one carefully set table.
real_life.premise: You check an evening booking at a neighborhood restaurant and discover two families paid deposits for the same anniversary table as both parties enter together.
actions: Check both deposit receipts against the booking history.
Ask each family which part of the evening matters most.
Offer the private alcove after confirming it is truly available.

real_life.title: The Last Box in the Lift
real_life.tagline: Ten minutes of lift access will not move everybody's day.
real_life.premise: You meet neighbors at a moving-day lift and learn its maintenance shutdown starts in ten minutes while an older resident's essential belongings remain upstairs.
actions: Ask the maintenance crew whether a safe brief delay is possible.
Identify the resident's essential boxes before moving anything else.
Organize neighbors to clear the lift's waiting area.

romantic.title: The Duet Behind the Curtain
romantic.tagline: The melody that broke your engagement now needs your harmony.
romantic.premise: You arrive for a candlelit court recital and discover your assigned duet partner composed the anonymous melody that ended your last engagement.
actions: Ask your duet partner where the melody began.
Rehearse the difficult passage while watching their unguarded reaction.
Request a private minute before the curtain rises.

romantic.title: The Orange Tree Truce
romantic.tagline: The tree remembers a promise neither of you has explained.
romantic.premise: You enter a palace conservatory to negotiate a border garden and find your former beloved tending the tree planted for a promise neither of you fulfilled.
actions: Ask your former beloved why they kept tending the tree.
Discuss the border garden before either of you mentions the past.
Offer to finish the pruning together away from the court's gaze.

romantic.title: The Invitation in Unfinished Ink
romantic.tagline: Your fiercest critic is rehearsing tenderness in your hand.
romantic.premise: You deliver a ceremonial invitation to a moonlit terrace and catch your sharpest critic practicing a reply to a love declaration in your own handwriting.
actions: Ask to see the unfinished reply before delivering the invitation.
Compare the handwriting without concealing your recognition.
Set the ceremonial envelope aside and ask whom they hoped to answer.

revenge.title: The Funeral Seat Reserved
revenge.tagline: Someone has placed the last witness within your reach.
revenge.premise: You return by midnight train to the funeral of the broker who sold your family and find your seat reserved beside the only witness your enemies failed to silence.
actions: Inspect the seating token for the hand that arranged it.
Approach the witness before the mourners take their places.
Watch the broker's associates from the station-side entrance.

revenge.title: The Quarry Payroll
revenge.tagline: The wages may reveal who paid for your sentence.
revenge.premise: You enter a rain-soaked workers' diner with proof that the foreman bought your conviction and learn his wage courier will arrive before the witness can escape.
actions: Compare the payroll seal with the proof of your conviction.
Arrange a quiet back exit for the waiting witness.
Observe the courier's escort before choosing an approach.
